143: People who do wrong with the wife of a friend who trusts them completely are surely no better than dead.
161: Make it a rule of your life to keep your heart free of jealousy.
180: Wanting others’ things without thinking about the result leads to ruin. The great strength of not wanting them leads to victory.
201: Bad people are not afraid of the pride that comes from doing wrong. Truly good people are afraid of it.
228: People with hard hearts keep their things to themselves, only to lose them in the end. Do they not know the joy of giving and of being glad about it?
245: Sorrow never comes to people who live with kindness. This great, rich earth, where the wind blows, is the proof.
247: The next world has nothing for people without kindness, just as this world has nothing for people without money.
